title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
description: Join Google's engineering teams for a 12-14 week summer internship working on core software products, large-scale systems, infrastructure, or AI research.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from participating countries worldwide.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, health insurance, airfare)
description: Enables international graduate students and young professionals to study and conduct research at universities across the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: 1+ years of experience with JavaScript, modern web frameworks (Vue/React), and Git version control.
qualification: Bachelor's in CS or equivalent self-taught practical experience
description: Work remotely with a globally distributed team to build user interfaces and enhance features for GitLab's open-source DevSecOps platform.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally interested in computer science and programming fundamentals.
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that teaches algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Imagine Cup Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university.
qualification: Current high school or university student
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build innovative solutions using Microsoft Azure, AI, and cloud services to address real-world problems.

title: OpenAI Residency Program
eligibility: Exceptional engineers, researchers, and self-taught innovators looking to transition into AI research.
qualification: Strong background in mathematics, software engineering, or related STEM disciplines
description: A full-time, 6-month pathway designed to transition talented technical minds into AI research and empower them to build cutting-edge artificial intelligence systems.
